CustomField.description: Platform-managed lookup. Populated by the Fundraising engine when a schedule's `StartDate` arrives (past-or-today), not at insert time. Do not back-fill in flows or Apex — that overrides the platform's active-vs-pending semantics and breaks reports that filter on `CurrentGiftCmtScheduleId != null` to identify actively giving commitments. See [[gc-current-schedule-activation]].
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically. The gift commitment schedule currently in force. The platform populates this when a schedule's Start Date is today or earlier. Records with a future Start Date leave this field blank until activation.
